notes:
Spotify tells you what song is playing.

THE SONG, THE ARTIST AND THE COVER, on any Spotify playlist. Sorriva was reading the one field Spotify leaves empty; it publishes all of it somewhere else. Verified in the room, updating both when a playlist advances on its own and when you skip a track by hand.

SONOS RADIO ARTWORK CONFIRMED. It shipped last release without ever having been seen on a live card. It has now — the song, the artist and the cover, under the right station name.

NOT IN THIS RELEASE: the Spotify PLAYLIST name. The speaker does report it, but only through a channel Sorriva does not yet listen on — the same channel that would likely fix SiriusXM, which still reads Unknown while playing. Both are now one piece of work rather than two investigations.

KNOWN ISSUE, FOUND WHILE TESTING THIS: after the app comes back to the foreground at the same moment the network reconnects, it can stop updating every zone until you relaunch it. Volume and play state freeze along with the track. It is logged with the evidence needed to fix it properly.
